from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/57317/1_57317_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/57317_0_b6e55758/1_57317_output.xlsx")

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws_data = wb["Data"]
ws_find = wb["Find"]

# Product entered by the user on the Find sheet
product_to_find = ws_find["A3"].value

# Locate headers on the Data sheet
header_row = None
product_col = None
customer_col = None

for row in ws_data.iter_rows():
    values = [cell.value for cell in row]
    if "Product" in values and "Customer" in values:
        header_row = row[0].row
        product_col = values.index("Product") + 1
        customer_col = values.index("Customer") + 1
        break

# Collect all customers who bought the selected product
matches = []
if header_row is not None:
    for r in range(header_row + 1, ws_data.max_row + 1):
        if ws_data.cell(r, product_col).value == product_to_find:
            matches.append(ws_data.cell(r, customer_col).value)

# B4 is already the first displayed customer, so fill B5:B9 with subsequent matches
for i, row_num in enumerate(range(5, 10), start=1):
    ws_find.cell(row=row_num, column=2).value = matches[i] if i < len(matches) else None

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
